issue.body:
Finding key: `atp-bibliography-owner-qa`

Independent audit of the ATP finalization preparation found a bounded coverage gap in `page_qa.py::inspect_page`: it verifies reference-N anchor existence and finds reference IDs/titles in global page text, but does not bind each title and source URL to its own bibliography entry. The title/URL loop only evaluates title. A title or URL swapped between entries can evade these assertions. The separate site-current check remains valid; this finding does not assert that the current page has wrong citations.

Preparation: `/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-230-finalization-support-20261012`, handoff SHA256 `83cb11f3a27a8db6bc75956cc1b5bb850b19f387354e48595607608c6802f19d`. Maintain its original immutable audit evidence.

Resolution: add a separately reviewed supplemental check of the actual corrected ATP page, requiring the exact 94 ordered unique reference-N entries. Each entry must contain its own code identifier; source-link text and URL must obey explicit URL precedence and native resolver fallback, or remain plain text when no URL resolves. Check each owning entry's complete visible title/citation and source-version detail, including corrected reference-23 PMID:31464375. Preserve the native label markup semantics from `src/pathwaymech/cli.py` and `site_display.py`.

Acceptance: bounded controls reject swapped titles/URLs, wrong link text, duplicate or missing anchors and an incorrect reference-23 title. Run the check on the actual corrected page and exact YAML bytes; archive helper, outputs and explicit disposition with the native review. No new biological claim or full test rerun is required.

Severity: minor, external QA coverage gap. The original page checks remain useful within their stated scope, with the supplemental check required for bibliography ownership claims.
issue.title: Bind ATP bibliography QA to each rendered reference entry
